scripts.format: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --write ../index.html styles.css app.js data/content.json scripts/*.mjs *.json *.js README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --check ../index.html styles.css app.js data/content.json scripts/*.mjs *.json *.js README.md
